paragraphs: In the morning, collect the pattern and blank and position the protective film. At midday, guide the tool or apply etching solution while watching the reaction. Carefully cut through the protective layer during trimming. In the afternoon, verify precision and make corrections. Before leaving, maintain tools and equipment and organize the next day's orders.
